items.evidence: 158 of 1,620 top-level scripts/*.py files (9.8%) have zero inbound references anywhere outside themselves. Measured 2026-09-16 by scanning 7,838 repo files (extensions .py .sh .json .txt .md .yaml .yml .toml .cfg .ini .service .timer .html .js .ts .sql .conf, under 3 MB, excluding .git/node_modules/.venv/__pycache__/.mypy_cache/.pytest_cache) with one longest-first alternation regex over all 1,620 basenames, attributing each match to the containing file and excluding self-matches. Samples: agent_router_final.py, agent_router_reliable.py, apply_homehub_no_stop_label.py, apply_homehub_trust_wireup.py, audit_config_files.py, audit_health_schedule_drift.py, audit_phase2g_canary_status.py, audit_phase2h_bounded_approval.py, audit_phase3_media_prose_routing.py, audit_table_readers_without_writers.py. CORRECTION TO THE PLAN: the plan cites 288 (17.8%); the direct re-measurement finds 158. The method is deliberately conservative in two ways that UNDERSTATE the count -- substring matching means a script whose basename is a prefix of another counts as referenced, and .md documentation counts as a reference -- so 158 is a floor, not a ceiling.
